setup_sources.independence: each game samples its red and blue setups independently through the sampler's frozen per-side stream derivation
setup_sources.weighting: no setup family receives outcome-based weighting

game_identity.per_ply_policy_randomness: derive_decision_seed(policy_seed, ply) — the frozen Phase 4 per-ply derivation
game_identity.rng_rule: no global RNG cursor; every stream is a pure function of identity

decision_sampler.long_game_rule: T > 64: bin b covers [floor(b*T/64), floor((b+1)*T/64)); selected index = lo + (decision_bin_seed(game_id, b) % (hi - lo)); bins are disjoint and ascending, so selection is without replacement and already sorted
decision_sampler.outcome_independence: game outcome, teacher strength, future value and model predictions never influence selection

fields.name: legal_mask
fields.description: legal actions in the model (perspective-normalized) frame; used by the masked policy loss / action adapter, never concatenated into the observation

fields.name: acting_player
fields.description: engine player constant (RED=0, BLUE=1) before conversion

fields.name: policy_action_abs
fields.description: the action the rule policy chose, absolute engine id

fields.name: policy_action_model
fields.description: the same action in the perspective-normalized model frame via the frozen absolute_action_to_model conversion

fields.name: policy_weight
fields.description: frozen supervision weight of the acting rule policy

fields.name: value_target
fields.description: WIN=0 / DRAW=1 / LOSS=2 from the acting player's perspective

fields.name: belief_target
fields.description: dense_belief_target_v1 labels: true piece-type index on exactly the unresolved hidden opponent squares (model frame), -100 elsewhere

fields.name: belief_mask
fields.description: true exactly where belief is supervised

fields.name: decision_index
fields.description: 0-based ply index of this decision in the game

example_schema.privileged_boundary: privileged metadata (true hidden types, provenance, teacher identity) may ride on the example object but must never enter the model-input tensor

target_semantics.decision_definition: one decision = one recorded action of the trajectory, indexed 0..T-1 in ply order across both players; the acting player of the ply is the observer of every target

policy.target: the actual legal action chosen by the acting rule policy
policy.loss: masked cross entropy over legal model-frame actions
policy.masking: illegal actions are excluded from the policy normalization via masked_policy_log_probabilities (finite fill -1e9)
policy.zero_weight_rule: decisions with policy_weight == 0 contribute no policy gradient and still supervise value and belief

value.mapping: terminal winner == acting player -> WIN; draw -> DRAW; terminal winner == opponent -> LOSS (engine terminal_result_label is the outcome authority)
value.loss: categorical cross entropy over [WIN, DRAW, LOSS]

belief.supervised: opponent pieces still unresolved to the acting player: target square = perspective-normalized current square, target class = true piece type
belief.excluded: own pieces, empty and lake squares, captured pieces, and opponent pieces whose identity is already legally known
belief.loss: hidden-only masked cross entropy (per supervised square)
belief.privilege_rule: true types come from privileged replay state only after the public observation is constructed; they never enter any model input

policy_metric.weighting: weighted by policy_weight, normalized by the sum of weights — identical for the model and the baseline, matching the training-loss normalization
policy_metric.model_ce: -log p_model(chosen action) with masked log-softmax over legal model-frame actions
policy_metric.top1: argmax over legal actions; ties broken by lowest action id

policy_baseline.definition: uniform over legal actions: p(a) = 1 / legal_count
policy_baseline.expected_top1: mean(1 / legal_count) over the same population

value_baseline.definition: one constant W/D/L distribution: class frequencies fitted on train selected examples only; validation and test reuse that frozen train prior
value_baseline.accuracy_tie_break: lowest class index among tied maxima

belief_baseline.definition: observable unresolved-inventory marginal: p(type=t) = unresolved_remaining_count[t] / total_unresolved_remaining, computed from the acting player's observable information and applied independently to each unresolved hidden opponent piece
belief_baseline.top1_tie_break: lowest piece-type index among tied maxima

bootstrap.unit: game (all of a game's decisions/pieces resampled together)
bootstrap.method: numpy.random.default_rng(bootstrap_seed) draws one index matrix integers(0, n_games, size=(replicates, n_games)); each replicate recomputes the metric from per-game sufficient statistics; interval = 2.5/97.5 percentiles
bootstrap.pairing: ratio and difference intervals reuse the same index matrix for model and baseline (paired at the game level)

evaluation_contract.reporting: point estimate, 95% CI, number of games, number of decisions, number of hidden-piece targets

loss_semantics.policy: L_policy = sum_i(weight_i * CE_i) / sum_i(weight_i) over the batch's policy-eligible examples; a batch whose weights sum to zero contributes L_policy = 0
loss_semantics.value: L_value = mean CE over the batch's selected decisions
loss_semantics.belief: L_belief = sum of per-square CE over supervised squares / max(supervised square count, 1) — the frozen stratego.model.losses.belief_loss normalization, so hidden-piece count cannot silently scale the belief head's influence

fixed_controls.example_universe: the train split's frozen selected-decision universe under warmstart_decision_sampler_v1

selection.score: mean(r_policy, r_value, r_belief); r_head = validation head CE / frozen head baseline CE (warmstart_eval_v1 semantics); lower is better
hard_veto: any component ratio > 1.05 at the final pilot checkpoint

sealing_rules.validation_corpus: may select pilot configuration, best checkpoint and early stopping; may never update weights
sealing_rules.train_corpus: may update weights, fit the value prior, and drive optimization statistics

corpus_storage_schema.redirect: the root may be redirected to the external volume by explicit configuration; the manifest records the actual location and free space

trajectory.role: replay authority: setups, actions, terminal state

corpus_storage_schema.commit_rule: a game is trainable only once a commit record exists, written after both the trajectory payload and the synthetic/setup metadata exist and verify; resume reconciles persisted, metadata and commit ids, never duplicates a committed game, never exposes an orphan, and deterministically rebuilds or discards uncommitted work
